capabilities.text: Enter nurse notes once
capabilities.quote: The main pain point is definitely the double entry of nurse notes—it's the primary source of frustration and error.

capabilities.text: Sync notes to Epic EHR
capabilities.quote: When a nurse enters a note once in the new system, it must appear immediately in the Epic EHR as a new Clinical Note

capabilities.text: Sync notes to SharePoint handover spreadsheet
capabilities.quote: and be synced to the SharePoint handover spreadsheet within 15 minutes via a scheduled Azure Function.

capabilities.text: Read-only access for charge nurses and ward managers to notes on their assigned wards
capabilities.quote: Charge nurses and ward managers will also use the system, but with read-only access to all notes entered on their assigned wards.

capabilities.text: Administrator access to audit logs and system settings
capabilities.quote: Administrators will have full access to audit logs and system settings, but only for troubleshooting and compliance reporting.

capabilities.text: Web app accessible via Azure AD single sign-on
capabilities.quote: They’ll use the system via a web app accessible through the hospital’s Azure AD single sign-on

capabilities.text: Role-based access control for ward notes
capabilities.quote: with role-based access control: only nurses assigned to a specific ward can enter notes for that ward.

capabilities.text: Backend using ASP.NET Core on .NET 8
capabilities.quote: the backend will use ASP.NET Core on .NET 8, as it aligns with the team’s expertise

capabilities.text: FHIR R4 endpoints built using Microsoft.Health.Fhir.R4 library
capabilities.quote: The FHIR R4 endpoints will be built using the Microsoft.Health.Fhir.R4 library to ensure compliance with the EHR’s expectations.

capabilities.text: Version one live by October 15, 2024
capabilities.quote: Version one must be live by October 15, 2024, to align with the hospital group’s Q4 digital health rollout

capabilities.text: Tag notes with nurse's Azure AD identity
capabilities.quote: The note must be tagged with the nurse’s Azure AD identity and the timestamp in UTC to ensure auditability and compliance with HIPAA and GDPR.

capabilities.text: Tag notes with UTC timestamp
capabilities.quote: The note must be tagged with the nurse’s Azure AD identity and the timestamp in UTC to ensure auditability and compliance with HIPAA and GDPR.

capabilities.text: Budget capped at $280,000 for the full project lifecycle
capabilities.quote: Yes, the budget is capped at $280,000 for the full project lifecycle, including development, testing, and deployment through v1.1.

capabilities.text: Real-time dashboard for charge nurses and ward managers
capabilities.quote: The first thing a charge nurse or ward manager sees when they open the system is a real-time dashboard listing all active wards

capabilities.text: Dashboard shows visual indicator for pending/incomplete notes
capabilities.quote: with a visual indicator showing the number of pending or incomplete notes for each, updated every 5 minutes via SignalR.

capabilities.text: Drill down into ward to view recent notes
capabilities.quote: They can drill down into any ward to view a time-ordered list of the most recent notes, filtered by the shift’s active nurses and sorted by entry time

capabilities.text: Filter notes by status (entered, synced, failed)
capabilities.quote: with the ability to filter by status—“entered,” “synced,” or “failed.

capabilities.text: Handle PHI under HIPAA
capabilities.quote: This system handles protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA, so we must comply with the U.S. Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act

capabilities.text: Encrypt data at rest using Azure Storage Service Encryption with customer-managed keys
capabilities.quote: Data must be encrypted at rest using Azure Storage Service Encryption with customer-managed keys

capabilities.text: Encrypt data in transit using TLS 1.3
capabilities.quote: and in transit using TLS 1.3.

capabilities.text: Log and audit all access to patient data via Azure Monitor
capabilities.quote: All access to patient data must be logged and audited via Azure Monitor

capabilities.text: Retain audit logs for at least 6 years
capabilities.quote: with retention of logs for at least 6 years.
